body:
New research project `research/interval-scores` (stdlib Python, 7 tests, experiments, white paper), plus README and portfolio page entries.

- Winkler interval score is strictly proper for the α/2 and 1−α/2 quantiles; closed-form regret (normal, Cauchy)
- Optimal expected score exactly 4sφ(z)/α
- Width-misreport cost asymmetry flips sign with the coverage level
- Cauchy drift: scores have no mean, paired differences are bounded, so detection still works
